title: Napoleon's Europe

hook.deadpan: 1805. Napoleon is Emperor of the French. He would like the rest of Europe, please.
hook.epic: One man. Ten years. All of Europe.

end_card: Every year. Every border. Explore it yourself.
beats: Trafalgar
Britain wins at sea. Napoleon decides to stay on land.
Trafalgar: Nelson wins the sea, and dies winning it.
Austerlitz
Austria and Russia attack together. It does not go well for Austria and Russia.
Austerlitz: two emperors beaten in a single day.
Jena–Auerstedt
Prussia joins the war. Five days later, its army is gone.
Jena: the army of Frederick the Great collapses in a day.
Friedland
Napoleon and the Tsar make peace on a raft in the middle of a river. Really.
Friedland, then Tilsit: the Tsar makes peace. The Empire reaches its height.
Bailén
Napoleon puts his brother on Spain's throne. Spain objects.
Spain rises, and a French army surrenders at Bailén.
Wagram
Austria tries again. Austria loses again.
Wagram: Austria fights once more, and falls once more.
Borodino
1812. Napoleon invades Russia. So far, so good.
Borodino: the bloodiest day of the wars. Moscow lies open.
Berezina
Moscow is empty. Then it's on fire. Then it's winter.
The retreat from Moscow: most of the Grande Armée never comes home.
Leipzig
Everyone he has beaten shows up at once.
Leipzig, the Battle of the Nations: half a million soldiers. The Empire breaks.
Paris
The Allies take Paris. Napoleon gets a small island.
Paris falls. Napoleon abdicates and is exiled to Elba.
Waterloo
He escapes, comes back, and loses at Waterloo. Final answer.
Waterloo: the comeback ends in a single day.
